sundai:fc:6.hint: poseの現在分詞形から派生
sundai:fc:6.question: 「堂々とした」を意味する単語はどれ？
sundai:fc:6.fullSentence: The imposing castle stood on the hill.
sundai:fc:6.explanation: imposing: 堂々とした、印象的な。

sundai:fc:7.question: Rich people are often described as _____.
sundai:fc:7.fullSentence: Rich people are often described as affluent.
sundai:fc:7.explanation: affluent: 裕福な。fluent(流暢な)と同じflu「流れる」語根。

sundai:fc:8.question: 「つかの間の、ほんの一瞬の」を意味する単語はどれ？
sundai:fc:8.fullSentence: He gave a fleeting glance at the photo.

sundai:fc:9.question: Too much information can be _____ and confusing.
sundai:fc:9.fullSentence: Too much information can be superfluous and confusing.

sundai:fc:10.question: Stock prices have _____ wildly this month.
sundai:fc:10.fullSentence: Stock prices have fluctuated wildly this month.

sundai:fc:11.question: 「流入」を意味する単語はどれ？
sundai:fc:11.fullSentence: The city has seen a large influx of tourists.

sundai:fc:12.question: Please read the _____ before starting chapter one.
sundai:fc:12.fullSentence: Please read the preface before starting chapter one.

sundai:fc:13.hint: fable(寓話)と語感が似るが意味は別
sundai:fc:13.question: 「白状する、告白する」を意味する単語はどれ？
sundai:fc:13.fullSentence: He finally confessed to the crime.
sundai:fc:13.explanation: confess: 告白する、白状する。

sundai:fc:14.question: It was a _____ decision that changed his whole life.
sundai:fc:14.fullSentence: It was a fatal decision that changed his whole life.
sundai:fc:14.explanation: fatal: 致命的な。fate(運命、宿命)と同語源。

sundai:fc:15.hint: 興味を強く引きつける
sundai:fc:15.question: 「魅力的な」を意味する単語はどれ？
sundai:fc:15.fullSentence: I find ancient history absolutely fascinating.

sundai:fc:16.question: It was a great _____ for the young athlete to win the gold medal.
sundai:fc:16.fullSentence: It was a great triumph for the young athlete to win the gold medal.

sundai:fc:17.question: 「大騒ぎする」という意味の表現はどれ？
sundai:fc:17.fullSentence: Don't make a fuss over such a small mistake.
sundai:fc:17.explanation: make a fuss: 大げさに騒ぐ。fuss: 大騒ぎ。

sundai:fc:18.question: This ticket is no longer _____; it expired last month.
sundai:fc:18.fullSentence: This ticket is no longer valid; it expired last month.
sundai:fc:18.explanation: valid: 妥当な、正当な。validity(正当性)も覚える。

sundai:fc:19.question: 「両価的な、相反する感情の」を意味する単語はどれ？
sundai:fc:19.fullSentence: I feel ambivalent about moving to a new city.
sundai:fc:19.explanation: ambivalent: 相反する感情を持つ。ambiguous(あいまいな)と混同注意。

sundai:fc:20.question: His answer was so _____ that nobody understood what he meant.
sundai:fc:20.fullSentence: His answer was so ambiguous that nobody understood what he meant.

sundai:fc:21.question: 「周囲の」を意味する単語はどれ？
sundai:fc:21.fullSentence: I love the ambient music in this cafe.
sundai:fc:21.explanation: ambient: 周囲の。ambition(野心)と混同しない。

sundai:fc:22.question: The country appointed a new _____ to the United Nations.
sundai:fc:22.fullSentence: The country appointed a new ambassador to the United Nations.

sundai:fc:23.question: She has always been a strong _____ for children's rights.
sundai:fc:23.fullSentence: She has always been a strong advocate for children's rights.
sundai:fc:23.explanation: advocate: 主張する、擁護者。voc「声」語根。

sundai:fc:24.question: 「呼び起こす」を意味する単語はどれ？
sundai:fc:24.fullSentence: The old photo evoked many happy memories.
sundai:fc:24.explanation: evoke: 呼び起こす。revoke(取り消す)と混同注意。

sundai:fc:25.question: The government decided to _____ the old law.
sundai:fc:25.fullSentence: The government decided to revoke the old law.

sundai:fc:26.question: 「保証する」を意味する単語はどれ？
sundai:fc:26.fullSentence: I can vouch for his honesty.
sundai:fc:26.explanation: vouch: 保証する。voucher: 引換券。

sundai:fc:27.question: Teaching became her true _____ later in life.
sundai:fc:27.fullSentence: Teaching became her true vocation later in life.

sundai:fc:28.question: The company had to _____ hundreds of workers due to the recession.
sundai:fc:28.fullSentence: The company had to dismiss hundreds of workers due to the recession.
sundai:fc:28.explanation: dismiss: 解雇する、しりぞける。mit「送る」語根。

sundai:fc:29.question: 「伝える、送る」を意味する単語はどれ？
sundai:fc:29.fullSentence: Radio waves transmit information through the air.

sundai:fc:30.question: You can _____ this step if you already have experience.
sundai:fc:30.fullSentence: You can omit this step if you already have experience.
